### 经济新闻板块综述

地缘政治风险骤然升级：伊朗向以色列发射导弹，4月以来的脆弱停火协议濒临破裂，油价应声上涨，全球风险资产承压。上周五美股已因芯片股暴跌和就业数据强化加息预期而大幅下挫，周一亚盘开盘即现恐慌性抛售——日经225大跌4%，MSCI亚太指数跌超3%，恒生指数跌逾1%。中国市场方面，央行开展2185亿元逆回购，外汇储备规模略降至34422亿美元，人民币中间价调贬41个基点。欧洲方面，欧央行面临滞胀困境，联合发债呼声再起，而AI投资泡沫争议持续升温。同花顺社区显示商品期货全线暴跌，银锡金铜橡胶大幅下挫，市场恐慌情绪浓厚。

- [伊朗导弹袭击以色列，油价上涨](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html)
- [美股周五大幅收跌，芯片股领跌，就业数据加剧加息担忧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNTl9ISk5UdDFBUW5uMHVZdTdGZ1ZCdXFKb0lSVUNLaVFlWW9qOXlvakpWMmV6bF9DSF9UTUUyeEpQU1VhNFNlYWdZYVFDWlJDeHNYNVV0UnVRQVVXMV9SaTIyLWc5WndHYVVvVHZobGFkVS1XMGo1VzBDWVlLbE9mRUJmNWhNOFlqamI3V2F3dnhTMlNOYlp1SHhYS3lCa0J0QWxxZXFPenhYQjBlWHk4MzFCMGpGTzlUNllINGx5aFdkSTIwSU5uYk1lRW0)
- [AI超大规模数据中心成空头靶心，支出与回报不成比例](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html)
- [日经225大跌4%，MSCI亚太指数跌3%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE53OFVOYUdKcl94cVZlMk1BS051T0pGTWhKSE9OVU5aSE53UG5kd25CV1U1Yk1tSU1yMkY1bEV2QVFDTmdXOGtHODVIUWo4SEdleHQ0)
- [欧央行滞胀困境：通胀可信度vs欧元区增长疲弱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNTUk4RE9XdU1aYjRmcWwyT2poWk1xNVRwS3VmVFpBTloyTVBqNFh6aHNOM0M2Vk5TeU1KQ21QcXVub0djUXNmNEQ3U3ROZmVqVUtnSXpYTDl4R3lNSXJ2Rm9GMEZONWFpREN4SEpfUFVPQl9VVDc1c1RsSkpmQjd5eFJGNmRidnJYcldUbnBYQ0tsSmJycG9QYnRxM29FbmcwOGZUbG9OUWdTWjJi)
- [同花顺期市早参：加息预期引发恐慌，银锡暴跌金铜橡胶大跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBRMWoxMTBfVHFQVnM5SktLM1NqNGdmUUN2eEt4MUxqWVZGUkJnOW8tQU5JQkxhRU9WQVBTZkRtTmdlbkpYMmtSYTkyZjFrdWZoWDJ2ZWJsdGNqU2gzOGc)

**后续观察：** 本周焦点在于伊朗是否进一步升级军事行动，以及美国5月CPI数据（周四）能否改变市场对美联储加息的预期。欧洲央行也将于周四公布利率决议，滞胀压力下任何鸽派信号都可能被地缘风险对冲。AI板块的估值修正可能才刚开始，投资者应警惕科技股补跌。

Global markets are bracing for a volatile week after Iran launched missiles at Israel on Monday, shattering a fragile ceasefire and sending oil prices surging. The escalation compounds existing headwinds from hawkish US jobs data, which fueled rate-hike fears and triggered a tech-led sell-off on Friday. Meanwhile, structural concerns around AI spending, China's capital controls, and the ECB's stagflation dilemma add layers of uncertainty. Below, we parse the key developments across desks.

- **Geopolitical shock rocks markets**: Iran fired missiles at Israel, its first since the April ceasefire, threatening to widen the conflict. Oil prices jumped on Monday, and US stock futures initially sank before partially recovering. The Hang Seng fell over 1% and the Nikkei 225 tumbled 4%, while the MSCI Asia Pacific index dropped 3%. ([Oil prices rise](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html), [Fragile ceasefire in jeopardy](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/iran-fires-missiles-israel-ceasefire-strains.html), [Hang Seng falls](https://news.google.))
- **US jobs data spooks Wall Street**: Friday's nonfarm payrolls report reinforced rate-hike expectations, sending the S&P 500 sharply lower as chip stocks slid. Futures were mixed Sunday night as investors weighed the geopolitical shock against the hawkish Fed outlook. ([US STOCKS-Wall Street ends sharply lower](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNTl9ISk5UdDFBUW5uMHVZdTdGZ1ZCdXFKb0lSVUNLaVFlWW9qOXlvakpWMmV6bF9DSF9UTUUyeEpQU1VhNFNlYWdZYVFDWlJDeHNYNVV0UnVRQVVXMV9SaTIyLWc5WndHYVVvVHZobGFkVS1XMGo1VzBDWVlLbE9mRUJmNWhNOFlqamI3V2F3dnhTMlNOYlp1SHhYS3lCa0J0QWxxZXFPenhYQjBlWHk4MzFCMGpGTzlUNllINGx5aFdkSTIwSU5uYk1lRW0), [U.S. stock futures mixed](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-stock-futures-slide-oil-prices-surge-as-new-attacks-threaten-the-cease-fire-with-iran-6e433c90?mod=mw_rss_topstories))
- **AI hyperscalers become bear-case epicenter**: Jim Cramer warns that heavy AI spending by hyperscalers faces a demand-supply mismatch, creating a near-term bear case for stocks. The warning comes as the AI boom's costs and hypothetical returns are scrutinized. ([Why AI hyperscalers are now the epicenter](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html), [Billions spent and hypothetical returns](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jun/07/billions-spent-hypothetical-returns-the-ai-boom-explained-with-six-charts))
- **Hong Kong IPO boom shows cracks**: A growing number of pre-debut runups in Hong Kong IPOs turn sour after listing, a warning for the market vying with Wall Street for top IPO spot. Meanwhile, international firms are doubling down on Hong Kong's $2.95 trillion wealth hub status. ([Hong Kong's IPO boom developing performance problem](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/hong-kongs-ipo-boom-is-developing-a-performance-problem.html), [International firms bet big](https://news.google.))
- **ECB faces stagflation dilemma**: The ECB struggles to balance inflation credibility with weak eurozone growth. JPMorgan AM and Pictet break from the pack with a 'one and done' rate cut view. The case for joint European debt is called 'compelling' by ECB's Patsalides. ([ECB's Stagflation Dilemma](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNTUk4RE9XdU1aYjRmcWwyT2poWk1xNVRwS3VmVFpBTloyTVBqNFh6aHNOM0M2Vk5TeU1KQ21QcXVub0djUXNmNEQ3U3ROZmVqVUtnSXpYTDl4R3lNSXJ2Rm9GMEZONWFpREN4SEpfUFVPQl9VVDc1c1RsSkpmQjd5eFJGNmRidnJYcldUbnBYQ0tsSmJycG9QYnRxM29FbmcwOGZUbG9OUWdTWjJi), [JPMorgan AM, Pictet Break From Pack](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOc0RxNnZBVlJjckdRR0VaOGgzdXBvTjEtbFM5OVI4REdXQ2VpbHNaMEtwOVN3aG9pd3FPS2pPa3BockxiZFlMQjNiT0ZyclAzVXdjYllza3Uxa0ZkNm85ZkdjSzNKejFqa2lxd0haSTRrRHZDWGs4TXNsRzhKeHE0a3dvWDVKWGV3VGM5QWdZblhXWlJYdWdGaWNBTVBzVlRFcnY2MHROamdfM2JoMEdaRA), [Case for joint European debt compelling](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNR0dSZHJkd1pKamR0Wlk4dVZtVDFoQ1JuVGM0aVRfWGFfVHcwcGFpNlJhTV94UWNBX2pVaWdramEtdlhyV0xXRDFLYzZIUlZSZGg3djFEM3hjOWxJbWxNMUZFNGtNSHV2dHIxWlBMc3pOU2Vmd3A5NjYxeFRMcEYxcnZZMXJ5RzhoMTVyejJza1EwNkhvcWNzWWdDQmdZOVlzV0JLdkp4T2ZjdFJieF9KenlR))
- **China tightens capital controls; savers flock to Hong Kong**: Mainland Chinese savers are moving money to Hong Kong despite regulatory tightening. AXA and Standard Chartered are launching new wealth offerings for high-net-worth clients, while the Stock Connect scheme remains closed to mainland AI darlings. ([Mainland Chinese savers flock to Hong Kong](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNUVBrd0Uxb3N0YW1KdzY3Y1FMMkJXS0JRazNZLTkwZThmRUZGZ1d6WmdSV2x3Z0UwTGxlQzVIYjdnNFhROEtMNnBKeTYxU0pLbUxUZFlOa19OaVctMjhlQjZQdWhOdWtBZTJPRDZqS2hKcDNwX3BnOWpUV3k3UVltNk1tcVR3S0pJMENsV3M0dlRuSHVUVUNtbE56UGJpU0pVV0tTeVJxVi1FY0ppVTg5eW93RkdPSS1ZVy1nY1pzajFJbDUxMFZzVWp3), [AXA, Standard Chartered eye expansion](https://www.scmp.com/business/money/wealth/article/3356260/axa-standard-chartered-eye-expansion-hong-kongs-booming-offshore-wealth-market), [Why can’t investors buy mainland’s hottest AI stocks via Stock Connect?](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3356193/why-cant-investors-buy-mainlands-hottest-ai-stocks-stock-connect))
- **EU-China trade war warnings escalate**: EPP chief warns of an EU-China trade war, and an EU conservative calls for tougher trade policy on China. The Maersk surcharges on China trade routes add further pressure on East African importers. ([EPP chief warns of EU-China trade war](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxOZmtpX3EwazdURUJYOVpsWXhQdDRDeVZYMmdyNkVoc3dTS3c3SXZzLTJmbHVTTi1BUC1aWm54eHQyYTFoZlY1V1BhN1c5dTRtRGpIN1lnOElRcFVORVE2bnd5ZkRVQmtXNVJ1X0lkWkgzODY4MjY3M3VkU25mSE1MZnBzZDM5YUlyaUo2dzVtWEJENlBDQUtNWE1JZGUyRVJPcGJBcUJxa21WYmY5MWlZZ09rM1ZuZw), [EU Conservative Calls for Tougher Trade Policy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOMEZITlRCTzRYSlNVM0JTc242UjllLWg2RW5hNjZGR3MxZFdqRlhPLUFTRThmWEZTcW5NMk5BbTdPemVhRk5oNjNTUHNNa0pTZG5PTXVNdXF1QlUydFRQdThyMm4xWldQNjd6VmdPaTVNU2FKTVZCTks5YUlQVzQ5ZkNjNE1NQktkaUtnYXNfZGw5LS05TjF2UWhMTHZBRDJ6NXc), [East African importers on standby](https://news.google.))

**Watch next**: The Iran-Israel conflict's evolution will dominate short-term risk appetite, with oil prices and defense stocks in focus. US CPI data and the Fed's June meeting, alongside the ECB decision, will test the stagflation narrative. The World Cup kicks off June 11, potentially adding a liquidity lull. China's May trade data and Hong Kong IPO performance will reveal whether the boom is losing steam.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻板块呈现三大主线：中东战火重燃，美伊以三方博弈白热化；日韩关系在军事合作回暖与经贸摩擦中摇摆；中国高考与AI议题引发全民讨论。以下是关键动态：

- **中东冲突急剧升级**：伊朗首次向以色列发射导弹（NPR报道为停火后首次），以色列随即空袭贝鲁特郊区，称报复真主党无人机袭击（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0qyevk8139o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。美国特朗普政府呼吁克制，但其拉丁美洲政策也在使用军事胁迫（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/nx-s1-5845137/trump-is-remaking-u-s-policy-in-latin-america)），显示全球干预多线并行。
- **日韩股市受冲击**：美国加息预期叠加中东紧张，韩国和日本股市暴跌（[Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNOTlsZVFldTh1XzR3WHh2bXFHTFRqcUNGVjlya2IzTkczMTgzQjZjN2ZPM1ZNLUV6RU40ZGRKMEdXZ3J6ZmJOVGlzUmt3ZzB3M3k3TWRMYWhEMGM0Uk9waDFlaVRQS2ZQYW9YTE1MY2IwcEg3YkR1cHRfXy1oUWMtcEhvTFplRjkxdkNVbFduVjV0QjVMLTBLYzhSVHlNckNad0V2VnY4aWhNdzZIbzhEQnExTHVzUQ)）。
- **日韩联合军演恢复**：两国举行8年来首次联合搜救演习（[Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE0xc0FHNExSUkw3RVIxUkZWcnBrcEliM0x3TWtMWUFjSUEzekxlSU1tM21iWS1GV1Y0Qi1FVExMNmNIQVh0ci1STGlLQ2M2NkhwbmZ5cVhmT3M0UQ)、[Daily Excelsior](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOQ2lwSHh3RGNQcVc2bG9wZXdoOG5CcWpRSm03ejRBQldtLUhtRF9jV1VaWHl2UUctS3pETmRqaThFMkhCakdFeUpCazZPakJHcHNIcm5Rd2I0U0ZUY3F1Q0VPc3VWU0pxZGZzLTk5ZGF0VTI5ZUJnc04zVTFKRUZJZ2hPbzE1YnFDcjRrZXRCTlJaSUxiNk1ySGE1aW9NbjEzRTNLdA)），同时日方探求韩国解除福岛海鲜禁令（[Chosunbiz](https://news.google.)），经贸摩擦仍在。
- **中国高考开锣**：全国1290万考生参加（[中国教育新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5mM181ckFJRVdfWUxHLWhlc2Exc0w3TFYwTW41bHI3UW1ua1JEUEdRcXlkUnItc1NhU3A1VUMzOFZQWFYyRDdjb0lzbEY2cGI4S3FQVUhjLW9aUHBYVkhlbUtodklDSFVBZFJB)），各地护航细节见报，同时舆论热议“AI时代是否还要卷学历”（[中国经济网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTFB4emloMXVaOUZaVVpaRXpfOXZTMjh0Qk9mUDdBR2NvdjNGNWZzWHd3ZWc2VXBCdld3d3BXSlF3OEFRZlEtOUo3cnlDakRldnNDdlo2QkNQWGZHcUFQWE5tOFVvN000VVM1RnRJbkU1Zw)）。
- **知乎继续回购与ESG评级**：知乎上周五回购11万美元股票（[AASTOCKS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOUEE5ZjJwbFdZdXBWeFZOZjh1VUVwRHJDSFVCQ3R5NFFObm12c19TSkE5M3lGSkdVODQzTUVsNm9zUmJ4VTIwdFZpOWxqY2VPN1NQWm5PcjY0Tmk1eS1zdEt3OFRrb1JrNHNmV195OV9YSS02djkzSFY0dUdHdlJYY2xkVVJVOXYzVFRR)），华证指数给予BBB评级（[证券之星](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1qUzlYSTlqNEVRM0RBLVBscUZJN0xlblgxSDg5Tk9oVEM4ZDctTUs5YVNQRlA0Y0t5OHU1QVRpZlNxN2d1Vkd5LW91elZFTmVLcG5CUHBmcGpmY1phb0NNeg)），但2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO称加速AI商业化（[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)）。
- **特朗普拉美政策强硬**：NPR分析称军事打击、制裁成为特朗普拉美政策标志（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/nx-s1-5845137/trump-is-remaking-u-s-policy-in-latin-america)），与中东冲突形成双线压力。
- **世界杯影响力外溢**：伊朗参赛因签证和训练营问题复杂化（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgmpmp89dvro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)），美国签证限制引发全球球迷不满（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx212p8r28eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。

**后续观察**：伊朗导弹攻击以色列后，停火协议实质性破裂，需关注以色列是否全面报复及美国介入程度。日韩联合军演是关系回暖信号，但福岛海鲜禁令仍是敏感点。中国高考与AI讨论折射出教育焦虑与技术替代的深层矛盾。
society.en:
Today's social news is dominated by a dramatic escalation in the Middle East, where Iran launched a missile attack on Israel just hours after Israel struck Beirut, shattering a fragile ceasefire. In East Asia, Japan and South Korea resume joint naval drills for the first time in nearly a decade, signaling a thaw in security ties. Meanwhile, China's annual college entrance exam (Gaokao) draws 12.9 million candidates, with state media emphasizing educational reform and AI's impact on future work. A South Korean traveler's disappearance in Japan and growing fan anger over US travel bans ahead of the World Cup round out the human-interest angles.

- **[Iran fires missiles at Israel after it attacked Beirut](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/7/iran-fires-missiles-at-israel-after-it-attacked-beirut?traffic_source=rss)** — The first direct Iranian missile attack on Israel during the fragile April ceasefire complicates mediation efforts and raises the risk of a wider regional war.
- **[Trump urges restraint after Iranian missile attack on Israel](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/8/iran-war-live-trump-urges-restraint-after-iranian-missile-attack-on-israel?traffic_source=rss)** — US President Trump calls for restraint but his administration's shift in focus to the Iran war is reshaping America's posture globally, including in Latin America and the Middle East.
- **[Japan and South Korea resume joint Naval drills after seven-year pause](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOQ2lwSHh3RGNQcVc2bG9wZXdoOG5CcWpRSm03ejRBQldtLUhtRF9jV1VaWHl2UUctS3pETmRqaThFMkhCakdFeUpCazZPakJHcHNIcm5Rd2I0U0ZUY3F1Q0VPc3VWU0pxZGZzLTk5ZGF0VTI5ZUJnc04zVTFKRUZJZ2hPbzE1YnFDcjRrZXRCTlJaSUxiNk1ySGE1aW9NbjEzRTNLdA)** — The first such exercise in eight years reflects improving bilateral ties and shared security concerns amid regional tensions.
- **[Japan seeks talks with South Korea to lift Fukushima seafood ban](https://news.google.)** — Diplomatic ping-pong over Fukushima seafood import restrictions continues as Japan pushes for normalization of trade relations.
- **[Trump abruptly ends NBC interview after clash over 'rigged election' claim](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8k1xx6yzjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The president walks out of a TV interview after being challenged on election integrity, underscoring ongoing political polarization in the US.
- **[South Korean Traveler Vanishes in Japan, Last Words Were "Arriving in 10 Minutes"](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQcktDeld0dlNhRDNYTFJtb3VXXzhRSFN4WkVwNnplU1QyQS01QzVlbGgtWjFJUS1ITjcxRkwzbkhmeEs1RDd1T2t6S0xkWTh5ZmRkczNLNnNySllBMHYteE13Y1c2emdMdzNHdnhTYWRzX0ZyUkVDTU5WS0gtejBaZUxSeVdqdkxoUWlxczlXRGpWSnpjbFpHRnd3VkZpdw)** — A mysterious disappearance of a South Korean national in Japan raises cross-border safety concerns and media scrutiny.
- **[知乎(02390.HK)上周五回购逾11万股涉资11.6万美元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOUEE5ZjJwbFdZdXBWeFZOZjh1VUVwRHJDSFVCQ3R5NFFObm12c19TSkE5M3lGSkdVODQzTUVsNm9zUmJ4VTIwdFZpOWxqY2VPN1NQWm5PcjY0Tmk1eS1zdEt3OFRrb1JrNHNmV195OV9YSS02djkzSFY0dUdHdlJYY2xkVVJVOXYzVFRR)** — Chinese Q&A platform Zhihu executes stock buyback as it navigates declining revenues (down 23.6%) and pivots toward AI monetization.

**Watch next:** The Middle East escalation is the overriding risk factor—monitor whether Iran's attack draws a wider response from the US or Israel. The resumption of Japan-South Korea drills could face domestic headwinds, while China's Gaokao week will drive education policy debate. Keep an eye on any new developments in the Iranian missile attack fallout and the South Korean traveler case.

military.zh:
### 军事新闻板块日报

**导语**：过去24小时，中东战火重燃，伊朗向以色列发射弹道导弹，这是自停火以来首次直接打击；美军与伊朗在波斯湾互有攻防，五角大楼内部对战争持续时间产生分歧。与此同时，东亚安全格局加速调整：中国被敦促加快航母升级以应对日本军事扩张，台湾加强反舰导弹部署，解放军宣布对台湾海峡实施全面军事管辖。俄乌冲突中无人机攻防持续，克里米亚遭重创。海军领域，菲律宾在演习中接收美制NMESIS反舰系统，土耳其确认国产航母2032年交付。以下为要点梳理：

- **伊朗导弹袭击以色列**：伊朗发射多枚弹道导弹攻击以色列北部，以色列进行拦截。这是自双方达成停火协议以来伊朗首次直接攻击，标志着中东局势骤然升级。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-ballistic-missile-attacks-on-israel) 与 [Yahoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPMFRMQVVhcFdwa2wxRUJSTDE2MUVHekZGUS00c3p1dGkzb0ttdGNKcVV6TVY3NnBFbFBBandDRkF0NXFrUHpLTnZkOC0xdUVCODZzc3hGS0JGNmJ5UHdvbTJneVZUYjN0d0Q1WWhrMlozaGNWdGJkaVRiYkxiOXE1WXM5MldpNm5WbVBrOFZTSWo1RkdiVTMzWA) 均予确认。
- **美军与伊朗在波斯湾对峙**：伊朗向美军舰艇发射警告导弹和无人机，美军随即打击伊朗沿海雷达站，并拦截一艘与伊朗有关的无国籍船只。[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/flashpoints/middle-east/2026/06/06/us-strikes-iranian-sites-after-iran-launches-drones-in-latest-gulf-flare-up/) 与 [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/05/u-s-forces-interdict-ship-connected-to-iran-in-indian-ocean-iranian-oil-exports-see-decrease) 交叉印证。
- **五角大楼内部不安**：报道称美军高层认为对伊战争可能“远超总统预期”，恐慌情绪在五角大楼蔓延。[AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOcmtoUkVULTNFTTF4ZXB3eE5wNUZKcmNCYzUzQ0tha2lKMmJZZDRKUElfeTlMWGUwTHpnWWVpNDdmVVRoM0d4RmJxSzhVdmc2RUZUTkFySWxTU2N4VGpJNFFxeUVENENSTmlQeGZlbGpxc2JYdXV3WnJMRVYzbGNvN1RYeTgzN3BNVVE) 报道。
- **中国航母升级呼声再起**：鉴于日本加强打击能力，外媒报道中国被敦促加快航母舰队升级。[Interesting Engineering](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQVW1ZUHhIM1dGV0I4VVhUc3FFajg2Y2E2Q2x3dUw4aExmVDR6RDF6ZXg3Qkh4Yjd0cFFKNUFLUnRoZWFpQlEza1RMUW93T242cDNVZzRvempfMV95dWFsTUh0SUtKYzJUQ09Wb1hlNU9VVWt0NUptSDdocFVRd0o5ZU5YWjlEODdzYjVQdEgxQzZuYWZm) 与 [SCMP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNVmRzbzU1LTZDMUU3UWp3RFVMaV9CZDVQQmtPLTNrSFFka3dLSEFVUWxiRXBXZkFCdlgtR2ZCVGpBbkNRQ1lRTDcxaDIzZzFwalNKdUlFMTBSZVc3MUgyZHUzYVVvZkRWTkdYeHVlUlEtRnRFOC1IakRfaHBJVXVldGFfNm9UUlRXN0VWNHFVMDZDNURvOVhRVWUzVkNROVRkMmFwY2MwMi1PdzhvanA0RFhZVTZ5WHFmZ283NkZnMzB5OGlUNm9R) 均提及。
- **台湾强化反舰导弹部署**：为应对中国大陆入侵威胁，台湾大幅扩充反舰导弹武库。[The Business Standard](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOY1hkSGFiNlZzUjUtbUZyZzRaM2JsQmxmcTNLWEwya1BhY3pJdFR0NVhEUlRyMlNVQTJLVkp6bFoyaWlULWlWZG1iaWdvWjhrTm5FaWIta2czeW1vRTVnbkdQUUt6R0xUamR4NEVuT2RReFRFWEhsbnJreFNZQnY5cnlpZHl2WFF1bDJmUXBMckpTUHgwN184RnpmLWZVQ0RhYVlZSTB5WmMxLUZh) 报道。
- **乌克兰无人机重创克里米亚**：乌克兰无人机袭击克里米亚交通枢纽，俄方声称在13小时内拦截339架无人机。[Devdiscourse](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQWEJuc0FGaUxaVjR2aFhrbEs3eFdTdE5jQjBUQnMyWG1CUGwxcVoxVHRDUXRKakdiMi16ZXBqcTNUcVBaMFhnYUN1RjZfanJVV05YWUgyajN1cWZfUHFMMGFIWkFGVjNrdWtZZ1YyUDBzc0xudXhKWHc4OWhDNlhmS1pNdVFscUtiMWhTR2M1UmF6dXQxNzBaYTZCSmtzT1VfcE1QLQ) 与 [MSN](https://news.google.) 均提及。
- **菲律宾引入美制NMESIS反舰系统**：在“肩并肩”演习中，菲军首次操作美海军陆战队新型反舰导弹系统，旨在加强南海拒止能力。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/the-philippines-meets-its-nmesis-in-balikatan-exercise/) 报道。
- **土耳其确认国产航母“MUGEM”2032年交付**：土耳其海军公布详细规格，标志着其海军战略进一步向远洋迈进。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/turkish-navy-confirms-2032-delivery-date-for-mugem-aircraft-carrier/) 报道。

**后续观察**：中东战事走向是最大变量——伊朗与以色列的直接交火可能打破地区脆弱平衡，而美军深度介入将牵动全球能源与航运市场。东亚方面，中日军事竞赛加速“航母对航母”格局，台海与南海海上摩擦风险持续升高。俄乌战线则进入“无人机绞杀战”阶段，双方都在寻求远程打击的战术突破。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a sharp escalation in the Iran-Israel conflict, with Tehran launching its first ballistic missile attack on Israel since a ceasefire, triggering US strikes on Iranian coastal sites. Simultaneously, China is being urged to accelerate carrier upgrades in response to Japan's military buildup, while the Ukraine-Russia drone war intensifies with Kyiv striking a nuclear site. Naval developments include Turkey's confirmed carrier delivery date and the Philippines fielding US anti-ship systems. These events signal a volatile multi-front security environment with significant economic and strategic ripple effects.

- **Iran-Israel War Escalates:** Iran launched ballistic missiles at Israel in response to the IDF bombing Beirut, marking the first such attack since the ceasefire began. Interceptions were seen over northern Israel, and the US struck Iranian radar sites after Iran launched drones toward the Strait of Hormuz. ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/iran-launches-ballistic-missile-attacks-on-israel), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/flashpoints/middle-east/2026/06/06/us-strikes-iranian-sites-after-iran-launches-drones-in-latest-gulf-flare-up/))
- **Pentagon Fears Protracted Conflict:** Reports indicate US military planners are preparing for a war that could go "far longer" than President Trump predicted, with growing panic at the Pentagon over a drawn-out battle. The cost of replacing every US aircraft lost in Iran is being assessed. ([AOL.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOcmtoUkVULTNFTTF4ZXB3eE5wNUZKcmNCYzUzQ0tha2lKMmJZZDRKUElfeTlMWGUwTHpnWWVpNDdmVVRoM0d4RmJxSzhVdmc2RUZUTkFySWxTU2N4VGpJNFFxeUVENENSTmlQeGZlbGpxc2JYdXV3WnJMRVYzbGNvN1RYeTgzN3BNVVE), [Simple Flying](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE5MRE5ualV0QkRXWFRaMlIza2JWaTViZTF3Unk2V2tTUkZtNlB1MS1ySHZBd2NCU2x6ZFhTRFRUZ0VwU0daOFE4ZFYxejBQQzFHc2U2b0h3WEJJSkNmdi15eENFbnRlTDREOUEwZklOckpIWGxrbjdHa0VHSQ))
- **China Urged to Fast-Track Carrier Fleet Upgrades:** Amid Japan's growing strike capabilities and deployment of ground forces to the South China Sea, Chinese state media and analysts are pushing for accelerated aircraft carrier modernization, including possible upgrades to Liaoning and Shandong. ([South China Morning Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNVmRzbzU1LTZDMUU3UWp3RFVMaV9CZDVQQmtPLTNrSFFka3dLSEFVUWxiRXBXZkFCdlgtR2ZCVGpBbkNRQ1lRTDcxaDIzZzFwalNKdUlFMTBSZVc3MUgyZHUzYVVvZkRWTkdYeHVlUlEtRnRFOC1IakRfaHBJVXVldGFfNm9UUlRXN0VWNHFVMDZDNURvOVhRVWUzVkNROVRkMmFwY2MwMi1PdzhvanA0RFhZVTZ5WHFmZ283NkZnMzB5OGlUNm9R))
- **Taiwan Beefs Up Anti-Ship Missile Arsenal:** In response to the rising threat of a Chinese invasion, Taiwan is expanding its anti-ship missile capabilities, adding to regional deterrence dynamics. ([The Business Standard](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOY1hkSGFiNlZzUjUtbUZyZzRaM2JsQmxmcTNLWEwya1BhY3pJdFR0NVhEUlRyMlNVQTJLVkp6bFoyaWlULWlWZG1iaWdvWjhrTm5FaWIta2czeW1vRTVnbkdQUUt6R0xUamR4NEVuT2RReFRFWEhsbnJreFNZQnY5cnlpZHl2WFF1bDJmUXBMckpTUHgwN184RnpmLWZVQ0RhYVlZSTB5WmMxLUZh))
- **Ukraine Drone War Intensifies:** Ukraine launched a drone strike that disrupted transit in Crimea, while Russia claimed to have intercepted 339 Ukrainian drones in 13 hours. A strike also hit a Ukrainian nuclear site, prompting Zelensky to meet allies in Britain. ([Devdiscourse](https://news.google.), [MSN](https://news.google.), [The Straits Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOMHhjRUptbnQxb2lQYnQtU2lhM1BKOVU1a0RjTXlWdTk2aGNvbGJUYUo5bW9EdXIzdzc5ZzlpaEVBbUhEb1FZdmNFbkg2Z2RHSUxvbjNhSjJqbTE0ZkZyazB3QXhOSU1sR0ZOUXVaMHRhN3V0OHlzMEVaREZFV3JyeTNvNFRhUUVienVlZGVfbVNaWDBvVzVGQjJjTFc4R0NXWUU0UHd1YldyZU9uV09OVmhiaw))
- **Naval Developments in the Indo-Pacific:** The Philippine military tested the US NMESIS anti-ship system during Balikatan, while Turkey confirmed a 2032 delivery for its MUGEM aircraft carrier. The US also interdicted a stateless vessel linked to Iran in the Indian Ocean. ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/the-philippines-meets-its-nmesis-in-balikatan-exercise/), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/event-news/cne-2026/2026/06/turkish-navy-confirms-2032-delivery-date-for-mugem-aircraft-carrier/), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/05/u-s-forces-interdict-ship-connected-to-iran-in-indian-ocean-iranian-oil-exports-see-decrease))

**Watch next:** The Iran-Israel conflict shows no signs of de-escalation, with potential for further strikes on energy infrastructure and Strait of Hormuz disruptions. China-Japan rivalry in the South China Sea may intensify as Beijing asserts full military jurisdiction over the Taiwan Strait. The Ukraine war continues to see high drone attrition, and naval force modernization across Turkey, Canada, and the Philippines signals a broader shift in maritime deterrence postures. Energy markets remain volatile due to Gulf tensions.

tech.zh:
本周科技新闻焦点集中在游戏产业夏季发布潮与AI领域的深层争议。微软Xbox 25周年展示会宣布《战争机器：E-Day》为Xbox独占，放弃了多平台策略，同时推出透明绿色限定主机与《我的世界：地下城2》等新作；Summer Game Fest上《女神异闻录6》正式官宣，引发JRPG玩家狂欢。AI方面，OpenAI推出“锁定模式”防御提示注入攻击，而多位AI领袖联名支持DNA筛选作为生物安全关卡，地缘政治层面则出现中国招募美国顶尖人才建设聊天机器人的担忧。HackNews社区热帖聚焦技术还原与个人重建：从Firefox合并Vulkan视频解码到线性app性能分析，再到一位开发者从成瘾与监狱中重建人生的励志故事。汽车领域，通用汽车豪掷9亿美元押注电动汽车电池，丰田或推出模拟手动变速箱对抗现代，比亚迪则为澳大利亚市场定制新车型。

- [微软Xbox 25周年：独占策略回归与透明绿色限定机](https://www.theverge.com/news/945359/microsoft-xbox-25th-anniversary-console-controller-release-date) — 《战争机器：E-Day》确认仅登陆Xbox和PC，与早前PS5传闻相反，标志着微软可能收缩跨平台战略。同时，透明绿色Xbox Series X纪念主机将于11月发售。
- [《女神异闻录6》正式公布，2027年见](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945256/persona-6-teaser) — Atlus在Summer Game Fest上发布30秒预告，以墓地与有毒绿色为主视觉，确认系列新作存在，但具体平台和玩法尚待公开。
- [OpenAI推出“锁定模式”防御提示注入](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1LUi00LW91X21WY014QXpoVWN3ZWpXdDRNZ2JYWHA1VzVJbDdpTHZMUnNoM2NucmJ4ckgtM1R1VXJRYl9wQVNGT01OUU9XeXhDLW5TS2VBSVdOVGUzclg3b1ctR204bmNBT1B4Vm5XMWx5WDV6RDJlejRR) — 针对日益猖獗的Prompt Injection攻击，OpenAI推出新安全功能，体现大模型部署中攻防升级。
- [AI领袖联名支持DNA筛选作为生物安全关卡](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOZ2lWRUFMNmtFRmF5blZrVmlWOWRMYXA2bHlrT2xldFVvM3ZnVXYwRXYxS2MwLTRVeXg3dWpvbW40WU1tZUFrcWlacDd0SkVZdHJTaHFZdkNEaEpzN3JWTk0wa2llYVhTeFlZazdKaE9YQ2xQaDRxLV9rSlk2YW04a1pWVURkUFpmRzlzRnlVQlp5U1BOYXZwQWJFaXU) — Google、OpenAI、Anthropic、Microsoft等高层联合发声，主张在AI生物技术滥用风险中建立早期筛查机制。
- [通用汽车9亿美元豪赌电动汽车电池](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/07/inside-gms-900m-ev-battery-gamble/) — TechCrunch分析称，这笔投资旨在解决电池供应链短板，但面临技术路线与成本不确定性。
- [HackNews热帖：从零开始——成瘾、监狱与重获新生](https://gavinray97.github.io/blog/building-from-zero-after-addiction-prison-felony) — 一位开发者分享如何用技术重建人生的真实故事，获401票，反映社区对韧性故事的共鸣。
- [丰田或推出模拟手动变速箱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOb2VfcjF4c1p4T3N2czVNSU1pb0w4NDd1aC14MHNtbHIxOEZHYkhXNWFOSGJrTXg2UTNoVktrUnkwYkQwbnNzTHVLN2poZ2M2NUpxbVZ3ZEZwbUVLQzBWZGZ0Sm1HdTV6REZnRHd4ZVhfeWxmR3VvV0ZCNHk5amZySGpFSFVINEZxWEgyeEZaaENYS3h6T2V4a1otcVJZVy00WTFrUWZBYVlNdw) — 继现代之后，丰田被曝正在研发模拟手动变速器技术，旨在保留电动车驾驶乐趣，可能改变市场格局。

**后续观察**：游戏独占策略的反复（如微软Xbox独占回归）预示行业正在重新评估跨平台发行价值；AI安全从提示注入防御到生物伦理约束的拓展，表明大模型治理进入实质性协商阶段；HackNews社区对个人成长与技术细节的关注持续升温，反映开发者对真实深度内容的渴求。
tech.en:
Today's tech news is dominated by a cascade of major gaming announcements from Summer Game Fest and the Xbox Games Showcase, signaling a robust rebound for the industry despite hardware uncertainties. Meanwhile, AI safety and biosecurity debates intensify, the EV sector sees strategic moves from GM and BYD, and the Hacker News community highlights both technical deep-dives and personal resilience stories.

- **Xbox doubles down on exclusivity** – Microsoft confirmed that *Gears of War: E-Day* will be an Xbox console exclusive, reversing earlier rumors of a PS5 launch ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945269/gears-of-war-e-day-ps5-launch)). The move underscores a strategic retreat from multiplatform releases to bolster the Xbox ecosystem.
- **Persona 6 finally teased** – Atlus released a brief, eerie trailer for *Persona 6* with a graveyard aesthetic, confirming its existence but little else ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2189059/persona-6-is-coming-with-graveyard-visuals-and-a-toxic-green-color-scheme/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/945256/persona-6-teaser)). The JRPG revival also includes *Persona 4 Revival* with a February 2027 release date and new voice actors.
- **AI leaders back DNA screening as biosecurity chokepoint** – Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft jointly endorsed DNA screening to prevent AI-enabled biological threats, signaling a rare unified stance ([WinBuzzer via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOZ2lWRUFMNmtFRmF5blZrVmlWOWRMYXA2bHlrT2xldFVvM3ZnVXYwRXYxS2MwLTRVeXg3dWpvbW40WU1tZUFrcWlacDd0SkVZdHJTaHFZdkNEaEpzN3JWTk0wa2llYVhTeFlZazdKaE9YQ2xQaDRxLV9rSlk2YW04a1pWVURkUFpmRzlzRnlVQlp5U1BOYXZwQWJFaXU)).
- **OpenAI launches 'Lockdown Mode'** – A new feature to block prompt injection attacks, reflecting growing enterprise security concerns around LLMs ([Yellow.com via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1LUi00LW91X21WY014QXpoVWN3ZWpXdDRNZ2JYWHA1VzVJbDdpTHZMUnNoM2NucmJ4ckgtM1R1VXJRYl9wQVNGT01OUU9XeXhDLW5TS2VBSVdOVGUzclg3b1ctR204bmNBT1B4Vm5XMWx5WDV6RDJlejRR)).
- **GM's $900M EV battery gamble** – TechCrunch delves into General Motors' massive investment in domestic battery production, a bet on vertical integration amid shifting EV demand ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/07/inside-gms-900m-ev-battery-gamble/)).
- **BYD develops Australia-specific model** – China's BYD is tailoring a new car for the Australian market, highlighting localization strategies to compete globally ([drive.com.au via Google News Autos](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQSEFpMXRwLWdnbWdUZXpieW0zSmVDVWVrYl83MG9EVTVuX0sxY3Q1VGt1Nm16MTJnZVNlRVVSYXlLMGZOTDdEdm9vOXlsRDVyMTJBOUFpUFpUTVR0a0c1MDV3czh5bnRUeHdMSWw4RkxkRV9ud09oTDNIT3Ytak9TLUlqemJXR1FjX3BUTjI5WXFZWkZvcmVuRzhxUks)).
- **SpaceX IPO reveals 'orbital AI compute' plans** – In its SEC filing, SpaceX proposes deploying AI compute at scale in orbit, merging space infrastructure with AI capabilities ([SEC filing via Hacker News](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026040610/spacexfwp.htm)).
- **Hacker News community highlights** – A personal story of rebuilding after addiction and prison received over 400 points ([blog](https://gavinray97.github.io/blog/building-from-zero-after-addiction-prison-felony)), while technical articles on perceptron from scratch, a Rust-based Wi-Fi light bulb, and Firefox Vulkan video decoding drew strong engagement.

**Watch next:** The fallout from the Xbox exclusivity pivot will likely shape console war narratives for the rest of the year. AI biosecurity commitments and OpenAI's lockdown mode could set new regulatory benchmarks. In EVs, GM's battery strategy and BYD's market-specific moves will be critical to watch as competition intensifies.

sports.zh:
世界杯倒计时一周，各队热身赛却接连出现意外：丹麦核心埃里克森在友谊赛中突然倒地，所幸已恢复意识；葡萄牙前锋莱奥因情绪失控拳击对手被红牌罚下；西班牙双星亚马尔和威廉姆斯因伤错过最后一场热身。NBA总决赛移师麦迪逊广场花园，特朗普到场导致场外球迷派对取消，圣安东尼奥马刺0-2落后但信心未失。羽毛球印尼公开赛落幕，加拿大新星赖浩俊力克强敌首次夺得超级1000赛冠军，改写了男单格局。以下是今日体育要闻：

- [埃里克森倒地后已清醒，丹麦足协确认无大碍](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48993108/christian-eriksen-collapses-pitch-denmark-ukraine) — 多信源交叉印证，比赛终止，球员已恢复交流。
- [葡萄牙前锋莱奥因拳击对手被罚下，热身赛2-0胜智利](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401862883) — 世界杯前暴露情绪管理问题，可能面临追加停赛。
- [西班牙亚马尔和威廉姆斯因伤缺席最后一战国足，首战佛得角存疑](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48993924/lamine-yamal-nico-williams-left-spain-last-world-cup-warmup) — 西班牙锋线年轻化战略遇挫。
- [弗洛伦蒂诺·佩雷斯在20年来首次有对手的皇马主席选举中获胜连任](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48995120/florentino-perez-re-elected-real-madrid-president-first-contested-vote-20-years) — 未来转会与俱乐部治理方向备受关注。
- [NBA总决赛G3：特朗普到场导致NYPD取消场外观战派对](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48993930/with-trump-attending-game-3-watch-party-canceled-nypd-says) — 安保升级，尼克斯球迷无缘集体观赛。
- [前公牛队三冠王球员斯泰西·金去世，享年59岁](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/48992706/stacey-king-3-nba-champion-bulls-dies-59) — 他退役后担任解说员，深受球迷喜爱。
- [加拿大新星赖浩俊印尼公开赛登顶，生涯首夺超级1000赛冠军](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxQN3JvMGlqV3Z3N3VXVEdvZHlnS1NVXzZkMy0zTzlwQmVKc251YVVpRmhSTDVXV2RBclFKUXp3RFI2eDk2eDd1cVE1MkhoMUFuSUkySDBOaGRpY3EzckJMQUd6emFSN010WFJfN3JLdUhIUlNpSjdZMjdxblY4TldlNTNORU84RkU) — 世界排名升至第9，打破亚洲选手垄断格局。

**后续观察：** 世界杯热身赛的伤病与纪律问题正在改变各队备战节奏；NBA总决赛G3的球场氛围与安保博弈将成为话题。羽毛球领域，赖浩俊的崛起能否引发国羽男单调整值得跟踪。

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条：第79届托尼奖揭晓，P!nk主持开场引爆舞台，A24新片《Backrooms》全球票房破纪录成为其历史最高；韩流方面，二代女团Secret时隔12年宣布回归，aespa、TREASURE等接连刷新销量与榜单成绩；国内影视业则聚焦AI赋能——桐庐AIGC影视创制中心启航，华策探索AI内容生产新模式；微博热搜则因“炎亚纶押中高考作文”“浪姐没念李心洁”等话题引发争议。以下为各板块详细盘点。

- [托尼奖：《Cats: Jellicle Ball》服装设计师Qween Jean成为首位公开跨性别托尼奖得主](https://deadline.com/2026/06/tony-awards-qween-jean-becomes-1236949456/) 开创历史，同时《Lost Boys》与《Schmigadoon!》领跑提名。
- [A24《Backrooms》全球票房突破2.12亿美元，超越《Marty Supreme》成工作室最卖座电影](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-backrooms-a24-record-1236942792/) 仅用10天达成。
- [韩国二代女团Secret发布回归预告，将于6月18日携特别迷你专辑《Secret Flavor》重返乐坛](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846081wpp/watch-secret-announces-comeback-date-with-teaser-for-1st-return-in-12-years) 距上次活动已隔12年。
- [浙江桐庐·富春江影视科技产教示范区AIGC高科技影视创制中心正式启航](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOS1FQTjNxeTRWUGQzV1B5WGFfUHdWTDBUeU1WYXI4bUlyNXJDVnBWZVZkcFlqM2dyWWRqcEtRZllMbThwY1RaWHJNSjRlWWRDZFFyTWJWTC1fVm1jRHRCcktGcVhIVU5RZXJneXRONjRidjkwSW1iR3JDN1MyT3R6Si1OR0E) 华策等企业联手布局影视AI新赛道。
- [黄子韬发文怒斥牙医偷拍并散播视频，引发明星隐私权讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNRHd5ZV9ZbG5WMFkwTGw3NUJNMEZTT2dwT3BxczZpZklNRi1RTGMxWGpUSkxscHBOZ0pRVnZma1lob3ZTV0cyZ09iUE0tR1UzZU9CWng2YnhCZHhOSDNVdnJvOUI5bWozalZYaHRTRDlQMUFyQmk0al8zVHpPdjU5WlpiU3gzUF9Y) 登上微博热搜。
- [John C. Reilly爆料曾劝小李子放弃《泰坦尼克号》出演《不羁夜》，理由竟是“那是艘会沉的船”](https://deadline.com/2026/06/john-c-reilly-leonardo-dicaprio-titanic-boogie-nights-1236949383/) 影史轶闻再引关注。

后续观察：托尼奖的多元化突破与K-pop的强劲回归表明全球娱乐市场仍处于内容创新与粉丝经济双重驱动阶段；AI在影视制作中的实际落地正从概念走向产业园级部署，值得持续追踪其对传统编剧、后期等环节的冲击；微博热搜的娱乐化与蹭热点现象需注意监管与公众情绪的交互影响。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape over the past 24 hours is dominated by the **79th Tony Awards** (hosted by P!nk), the **Asian film industry's AI pivot**, and a **K-pop comeback wave**. Broadway celebrated historic wins (_Cats_ costume designer Qween Jean became the first openly trans Tony winner), while A24’s _Backrooms_ crossed $212M worldwide to become the studio’s highest-grossing film. In China, the **AIGC film hub in Tonglu** marks a state-backed push to rewire content production, and Hong Kong cinema expands its mainland footprint via a Hangzhou showcase. Korean drama _Reborn Rookie_ more than doubled its ratings, and second-gen girl group **Secret** announced their first comeback in 12 years. Meanwhile, Chinese social media erupted over **Huang Zitao’s privacy complaint against a dentist**, **Xinhua’s endorsement of actor Bai Lu**, and viral debates about high-school exam essays. The FCC Chairman’s attack on fired _60 Minutes_ correspondent Scott Pelley underscores the ongoing U.S. media trust crisis, while Los Angeles mayor drama continues to mirror a Hollywood script.

- **[P!nk Hosts Tony Awards with Star-Studded Opener](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/arts/pink-2026-tony-awards-host-best-moments-1236616069/)** – The singer opened the ceremony with a _Lady Marmalade_ parody featuring Megan Thee Stallion, Lea Michele and Paddington the bear.
- **[Backrooms Becomes A24’s Highest-Grossing Film Ever](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-backrooms-a24-record-1236942792/)** – The viral horror adaptation earned $212.6M worldwide in just ten days, surpassing _Marty Supreme_.
- **[Historic Tony Win for Trans Designer Qween Jean](https://deadline.com/2026/06/tony-awards-qween-jean-becomes-1236949456/)** – _Cats: The Jellicle Ball_ costume designer becomes the first openly trans person to win a Tony.
- **[China’s AIGC Film Hub Launches in Tonglu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOS1FQTjNxeTRWUGQzV1B5WGFfUHdWTDBUeU1WYXI4bUlyNXJDVnBWZVZkcFlqM2dyWWRqcEtRZllMbThwY1RaWHJNSjRlWWRDZFFyTWJWTC1fVm1jRHRCcktGcVhIVU5RZXJneXRONjRidjkwSW1iR3JDN1MyT3R6Si1OR0E)** – Zhejiang province’s new AIGC high-tech film center aims to reshape content production and attract studios.
- **[Korean Drama ‘Reborn Rookie’ Doubles Ratings](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846088wpp/reborn-rookie-more-than-doubles-its-ratings-in-just-4-episodes)** – JTBC’s new show jumped from 3.7% to over 7% in four episodes, becoming the network’s highest-rated drama this year.
- **[Secret Announces First Comeback in 12 Years](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846081wpp/watch-secret-announces-comeback-date-with-teaser-for-1st-return-in-12-years)** – The iconic second-gen girl group will release mini-album _Secret Flavor_ on June 18, tapping into nostalgia.
- **[Huang Zitao Accuses Dentist of Privacy Violation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNRHd5ZV9ZbG5WMFkwTGw3NUJNMEZTT2dwT3BxczZpZklNRi1RTGMxWGpUSkxscHBOZ0pRVnZma1lob3ZTV0cyZ09iUE0tR1UzZU9CWng2YnhCZHhOSDNVdnJvOUI5bWozalZYaHRTRDlQMUFyQmk0al8zVHpPdjU5WlpiU3gzUF9Y)** – Chinese singer-actor posted a furious complaint that a dentist filmed him without consent and leaked the footage.
- **[Xinhua Endorses Bai Lu Amid Fan Debate](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9XLTA3eUZObUJ1eDdMYWVTcXhsaVFfci1sQkxCLTVxdzJsU292UWdhR09XT1luaWMtT3hJZ3Z2ek9WY3FtWGNXZDM5WVlvNWZhM0RQT0NpM0hyN1BlTUcxbUtPSQ)** – State media’s rare explicit support for the actress signals a potential boost to her industry standing.

**Watch next:** The Tony Awards momentum will drive Broadway box office this week; the Tonglu AIGC center’s first projects are expected to be announced soon; and the mid-June K-pop comeback race (Secret, aespa encore, TREASURE) will test whether nostalgia-driven releases can break through the current chart dominance of LE SSERAFIM and CORTIS.

- [AI超大规模数据中心成熊市核心论点](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html)
- [Delta欲挑战美联航在太平洋航线的主导地位](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/delta-takes-on-united-over-the-pacific.html)

地缘政治与通胀预期交织，本周美股面临严峻考验，科技股恐进一步下挫。
美股.en:
US markets face a double shock: a geopolitical missile strike and a hawkish jobs report that revived rate-hike fears. Friday's sell-off (S&P 500 sharply lower on chip weakness) has extended into futures mixed Sunday night as oil surged. The Iran ceasefire collapse is the critical new variable.

- **Oil surges after Iran fires missiles at Israel**: Crude jumped Monday, with Brent likely testing $80+, as the fragile April ceasefire is shattered. The conflict's broadening raises supply disruption risks. ([Oil prices rise](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/oil-prices-today-us-iran-missile-middle-east-israel-opec.html), [Fragile ceasefire in jeopardy](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/iran-fires-missiles-israel-ceasefire-strains.html))
- **Jobs data fuels rate-hike fears, chips slide**: Friday's nonfarm payrolls beat expectations, prompting bets on a Fed hike. The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell hardest; semiconductor stocks led declines. ([US STOCKS-Wall Street ends sharply lower](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxNTl9ISk5UdDFBUW5uMHVZdTdGZ1ZCdXFKb0lSVUNLaVFlWW9qOXlvakpWMmV6bF9DSF9UTUUyeEpQU1VhNFNlYWdZYVFDWlJDeHNYNVV0UnVRQVVXMV9SaTIyLWc5WndHYVVvVHZobGFkVS1XMGo1VzBDWVlLbE9mRUJmNWhNOFlqamI3V2F3dnhTMlNOYlp1SHhYS3lCa0J0QWxxZXFPenhYQjBlWHk4MzFCMGpGTzlUNllINGx5aFdkSTIwSU5uYk1lRW0))
- **AI hyperscalers under bear-case spotlight**: Jim Cramer warns the massive capex from hyperscalers (Microsoft, Amazon, Google) may not deliver near-term returns, making them the epicenter of a stock market bear case. ([Why AI hyperscalers are now the epicenter](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/cramer-hyperscalers-are-now-the-epicenter-of-a-bear-case-for-stocks.html))
- **Kevin Warsh sworn in as Fed chair**: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh took office May 22, and the FOMC unanimously selected him as chairman. Markets will parse his first statements for policy direction. ([Kevin Warsh takes oath](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/other20260522a.htm))
- **Delta challenges United over the Pacific**: Delta's president says the carrier aims to take United's crown on trans-Pacific routes, signaling intensifying competition. ([‘Bring ’em on’: Delta wants United’s crown](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/07/delta-takes-on-united-over-the-pacific.html))

The key signal: The combination of a hawkish Fed and escalating Middle East conflict creates a stagflationary impulse that could pressure risk assets further this week. Watch oil, the VIX, and the 10-year yield.

中国经济.en:
China's markets are caught between a geopolitical risk-off wave and domestic policy tightening. Hong Kong and mainland indices fell sharply on Monday, while the PBOC conducted 218.5 billion yuan in reverse repos. Capital controls are driving mainland savers to Hong Kong, while foreign firms double down on the city's wealth hub status.

- **Asian markets sink on Iran tensions**: Hang Seng fell over 1%, Nikkei 225 plunged 4%, and the MSCI Asia Pacific index dropped 3%. The sell-off was broad-based, with chips and tech leading losses. ([Hong Kong Stock Exchange Today](https://news.google.), [日经225指数大跌4%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE53OFVOYUdKcl94cVZlMk1BS051T0pGTWhKSE9OVU5aSE53UG5kd25CV1U1Yk1tSU1yMkY1bEV2QVFDTmdXOGtHODVIUWo4SEdleHQ0))
- **PBOC injects liquidity, but RMB weakens**: The PBOC conducted 218.5 billion yuan in 7-day reverse repos, signaling a neutral stance. The yuan midpoint was fixed 41 pips weaker at 7.1150, reflecting external pressure. ([央行公开市场开展2185亿元7天期逆回购操作](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE8tSzBieUxxcElyUWtyOWVYYWR3eHJVeF9mNlVZZDhHUnhjQ09pZkpqd0xISEdld0tUbUtPZWZPa080VU5BckZpNkpYb3NaU0g0S0VV), [人民币兑美元中间价调贬41个基点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5ObW55dkxxN09GT0dpX0dpc2xZYURNc0JkSjJHX1k3MGVkSzR0dTRZbkFMR3ppTFpWR1k0TlV2aDJmOHhma0F5WmtabmZMa0ZWYzRv))
- **Capital outflows to Hong Kong intensify**: Mainland savers are flocking to Hong Kong despite regulatory tightening. AXA and Standard Chartered are launching high-net-worth offerings, betting on the city's $2.95 trillion wealth hub. ([Mainland Chinese savers flock to Hong Kong](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNUVBrd0Uxb3N0YW1KdzY3Y1FMMkJXS0JRazNZLTkwZThmRUZGZ1d6WmdSV2x3Z0UwTGxlQzVIYjdnNFhROEtMNnBKeTYxU0pLbUxUZFlOa19OaVctMjhlQjZQdWhOdWtBZTJPRDZqS2hKcDNwX3BnOWpUV3k3UVltNk1tcVR3S0pJMENsV3M0dlRuSHVUVUNtbE56UGJpU0pVV0tTeVJxVi1FY0ppVTg5eW93RkdPSS1ZVy1nY1pzajFJbDUxMFZzVWp3), [AXA, Standard Chartered eye expansion](https://www.scmp.com/business/money/wealth/article/3356260/axa-standard-chartered-eye-expansion-hong-kongs-booming-offshore-wealth-market))
- **Stock Connect misses AI boom**: Frustration grows as hot mainland AI stocks (e.g., SenseTime, iFlytek) are not accessible via Stock Connect, while mainland investors miss AI IPOs in Hong Kong. ([Why can’t investors buy mainland’s hottest AI stocks via Stock Connect?](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3356193/why-cant-investors-buy-mainlands-hottest-ai-stocks-stock-connect))
- **Maersk surcharges hit China-Africa trade**: Container surcharges of $2,000 on critical China routes squeeze East African importers, adding to trade tensions. ([East African importers on standby](https://news.google.))

The key signal: China's capital controls are pushing wealth offshore, but the Stock Connect limitations and geopolitical risks temper Hong Kong's IPO boom. This week's trade data will test the export narrative.

欧央行将在滞胀阴影中谨慎行事，中东局势若恶化将加剧欧洲能源成本压力，贸易政策转向亦增加不确定性。
欧洲经济.en:
The ECB is caught between sticky inflation and weak growth, with JPMorgan AM and Pictet now calling for a single rate cut ('one and done'). The Iran war's 100-day impact on Europe is visible in energy costs and trade routes. EU-China trade tensions are escalating, while the bloc debates digital payment sovereignty.

- **ECB stagflation dilemma deepens**: The eurozone faces stubborn inflation alongside slowing GDP. JPMorgan Asset Management and Pictet break from the consensus, predicting a single cut. ECB's Patsalides argues for joint European debt issuance. ([ECB’s Stagflation Dilemma](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNTUk4RE9XdU1aYjRmcWwyT2poWk1xNVRwS3VmVFpBTloyTVBqNFh6aHNOM0M2Vk5TeU1KQ21QcXVub0djUXNmNEQ3U3ROZmVqVUtnSXpYTDl4R3lNSXJ2Rm9GMEZONWFpREN4SEpfUFVPQl9VVDc1c1RsSkpmQjd5eFJGNmRidnJYcldUbnBYQ0tsSmJycG9QYnRxM29FbmcwOGZUbG9OUWdTWjJi), [JPMorgan AM, Pictet Break From Pack](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxOc0RxNnZBVlJjckdRR0VaOGgzdXBvTjEtbFM5OVI4REdXQ2VpbHNaMEtwOVN3aG9pd3FPS2pPa3BockxiZFlMQjNiT0ZyclAzVXdjYllza3Uxa0ZkNm85ZkdjSzNKejFqa2lxd0haSTRrRHZDWGs4TXNsRzhKeHE0a3dvWDVKWGV3VGM5QWdZblhXWlJYdWdGaWNBTVBzVlRFcnY2MHROamdfM2JoMEdaRA), [Case for joint European debt compelling](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNR0dSZHJkd1pKamR0Wlk4dVZtVDFoQ1JuVGM0aVRfWGFfVHcwcGFpNlJhTV94UWNBX2pVaWdramEtdlhyV0xXRDFLYzZIUlZSZGg3djFEM3hjOWxJbWxNMUZFNGtNSHV2dHIxWlBMc3pOU2Vmd3A5NjYxeFRMcEYxcnZZMXJ5RzhoMTVyejJza1EwNkhvcWNzWWdDQmdZOVlzV0JLdkp4T2ZjdFJieF9KenlR))

This adds to uncertainty for European exporters. ([Why Europe needs greater sovereignty](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOZTBnaEFRcHJuOGpwRXpOa0JLYkxBZUlYbm5ZZy1Heml1WFZtNkdmWFZsNjFZYXMzdjh6Vk5tWEVibk5nc0FhRkhTRWNld0FGdWEta09UWnppMUQ1cXBGZTNHUkdET3B2TjdvQkdBR04xbzFNSXpMSXB1bnFqT2VPTE5pdjRLMFZHMEdSa1hrQlU1UjhLbTFHOTNwMUhqR2ZKeWlINE1zdExFMndEQ3dyZjNEU2lPU2h4NFFkRTNwSHE2V2FVTU9zY2xB))

同花顺社区动态.zh:

- [央行6月8日开展2185亿元7天期逆回购操作](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5EWlY3NllMdExoZGN5ajY4NG9udjNDS3JxeF84VXEwUHA3ek03WUV1SDRrdF9KUmVGYUkyS05YekZ3QnBGbVNfZlNMVU9MV0NSai1lelZRSk1WMzdZNGc)

- [备案私募证券产品增长近五成，多资产策略热度攀升](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HUmZBXzR6MkJFTjdaTHRQcGtMdmhFdnJ0UmtBSU9DYXMzN0RDeEIxbUpJNmZyTGIxLWJBZFlTZmdqQTg3VjlSeXUtVE4xb3Z3dE52b09Ud054UjZNWWc)
- [派瑞股份财务造假遭处罚，即将ST](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9SMUdOai1JRHlqQ0MtZXNtaGdjN1FfY3ZxTnBWYVRVTHNpQ29NZEs2WHRja1p5VzRpMDlyR2ljNDFFRlAxUFhKbU1oRk5jZDRFbjN0WkliY00xNkJRb3c)
- [期市早参：加息预期引发恐慌，银锡暴跌金铜橡胶大跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBRMWoxMTBfVHFQVnM5SktLM1NqNGdmUUN2eEt4MUxqWVZGUkJnOW8tQU5JQkxhRU9WQVBTZkRtTmdlbkpYMmtSYTkyZjFrdWZoWDJ2ZWJsdGNqU2gzOGc)

社区情绪偏空，投资者需关注6月8日商品期货夜盘是否延续跌势，以及派瑞股份ST对中小盘股信心的冲击。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors are reacting to a volatile mix of PBOC liquidity, forex reserves data, commodity price crashes, and a corporate fraud scandal. The tone from the Tonghuashun community reflects anxiety over global risk-off and domestic regulatory actions.

- **PBOC injects 218.5 billion yuan via reverse repos**: The central bank maintained ample liquidity, but the community is more focused on the geopolitical sell-off. ([央行：6月8日开展了2185亿元7天期逆回购操作](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5EWlY3NllMdExoZGN5ajY4NG9udjNDS3JxeF84VXEwUHA3ek03WUV1SDRrdF9KUmVGYUkyS05YekZ3QnBGbVNfZlNMVU9MV0NSai1lelZRSk1WMzdZNGc))
- **Forex reserves steady at $3.44 trillion**: China's May forex reserves held at $3.4422 trillion, providing a buffer but also highlighting capital outflow pressures. ([国家外汇管理局：截至2026年5月末我国外汇储备规模为34422亿美元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5xVjBoV0gyQzRFVU9lWTBoZlh1LTlyb2YtYVR6Q2VUNWhVRGJZOUJfbWE5WmxxdFgtLVZ3ZmFpVzdNNkN0eHdoWjFxSUl0c3lhZjREQWM1S1lJNjBJelE))
- **Rate-hike fears trigger panic selling in commodities**: Silver, tin, gold, copper, and rubber plunged on Monday, driven by a stronger dollar and rate-hike expectations. The community is buzzing about margin calls. ([【期市早参】加息预期引发恐慌，银锡暴跌金铜橡胶大跌！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBRMWoxMTBfVHFQVnM5SktLM1NqNGdmUUN2eEt4MUxqWVZGUkJnOW8tQU5JQkxhRU9WQVBTZkRtTmdlbkpYMmtSYTkyZjFrdWZoWDJ2ZWJsdGNqU2gzOGc))
- **Pai Rui shares fraud leads to ST designation**: The company was penalized for financial statement manipulation and will be labeled ST, a cautionary tale for retail investors. ([业绩调节踩红线 派瑞股份财务造假遭处罚 即将变身 ST 派瑞](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9SMUdOai1JRHlqQ0MtZXNtaGdjN1FfY3ZxTnBWYVRVTHNpQ29NZEs2WHRja1p5VzRpMDlyR2ljNDFFRlAxUFhKbU1oRk5jZDRFbjN0WkliY00xNkJRb3c))
- **Private equity fund registrations surge nearly 50%**: Multi-asset strategies are gaining popularity as investors seek diversification amid volatile markets. ([备案私募证券产品增长近五成 多资产策略热度攀升](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HUmZBXzR6MkJFTjdaTHRQcGtMdmhFdnJ0UmtBSU9DYXMzN0RDeEIxbUpJNmZyTGIxLWJBZFlTZmdqQTg3VjlSeXUtVE4xb3Z3dE52b09Ud054UjZNWWc))

The key signal: Retail sentiment is defensive, with capital rotating into multi-asset strategies and fixed income. The commodity crash and fraud case reinforce risk aversion. Watch for further margin unwinding in metals.

欧美.zh:
中东战火重燃成为欧美板块焦点：伊朗首次突破底线向以色列发射导弹，以色列空袭贝鲁特报复，美国试图斡旋但特朗普更关注拉丁美洲。同时美国国内政治激化，特朗普中断NBC采访。世界杯临近，美国签证政策引发全球球迷不满。

- [伊朗发射导弹指向以色列，停火后首次直接攻击](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/g-s1-126816/israel-iran-missile-ceasefire) — NPR称此举复杂化停火斡旋，伊朗意在恢复威慑但避免全面战争（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/quotable/2026/6/7/irans-attack-on-israel-aims-to-restore-deterrence-but-avoid-return-to-war?traffic_source=rss)）。
- [以色列空袭贝鲁特郊区，称回应真主党无人机](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0qyevk8139o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC报道美方斡旋休战仅几天后即破裂。
- [特朗普中断NBC采访，因“选举舞弊”争论](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce8k1xx6yzjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC视频显示总统与主持人激烈交锋。
- [美国签证和旅行禁令让世界杯球迷愤怒](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx212p8r28eo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC采访多国球迷感到被排斥。
- [乌克兰盟友设定和平条件](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7xr1g3nvvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 欧洲盟友在特朗普焦点转向伊朗的背景下提出条件。

中东冲突级联影响能源价格和全球市场，欧美需平衡多线危机，周二（6月9日）关注以色列内阁会议决策。
欧美.en:
The Middle East conflict dominates the European/American desk, with a rapid escalation after Israel struck Beirut and Iran retaliated with a missile attack on Israel. This breaks the April ceasefire and puts global diplomacy on edge. Meanwhile, US domestic politics show Trump walking out of an NBC interview over election claims, and his administration is reshaping Latin America policy through military strikes and sanctions.

- **[Iran war live: Trump urges restraint after Iranian missile attack on Israel](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/8/iran-war-live-trump-urges-restraint-after-iranian-missile-attack-on-israel?traffic_source=rss)** — The first direct Iranian missile strike on Israel since the ceasefire shatters the fragile truce; Trump's call for restraint may signal a desire to avoid full-scale war, but the risk of miscalculation is high.
- **[Israel strikes Beirut suburb days after US-brokered truce](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0qyevk8139o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — Israel says the attack was retaliation for Hezbollah drone strikes; the move undermines weeks of US-led mediation and complicates any future ceasefire.
- **[Trump is remaking U.S. policy in Latin America](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/nx-s1-5845137/trump-is-remaking-u-s-policy-in-latin-america)** — NPR analysis details how military strikes, sanctions, and political pressure are now defining US relations with Latin American nations, a trend amplified by the Iran conflict diverting attention.
- **[Pakistani workers say their faith cost them their jobs in the UAE](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/07/nx-s1-5832548/pakistani-workers-say-their-faith-cost-them-their-jobs-in-the-uae)** — Reports of Shia Muslim Pakistanis being deported from the UAE following the Iran war outbreak point to sectarian spillover effects in the Gulf.

**Signal:** The Middle East crisis is deepening and may trigger further retaliatory strikes or a humanitarian crisis. Readers should watch for US or UN diplomatic interventions and any escalation of Hezbollah-Israel exchanges.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块呈现军事回暖与经贸摩擦并行的格局：两国举行8年来首次联合搜救演习，同时日本积极寻求韩国解除福岛海鲜进口禁令。此外，韩国总统提名第二位女总理，日本进入超老龄化社会。

- [日韩重启联合海军搜救演习](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE0xc0FHNExSUkw3RVIxUkZWcnBrcEliM0x3TWtMWUFjSUEzekxlSU1tM21iWS1GV1Y0Qi1FVExMNmNIQVh0ci1STGlLQ2M2NkhwbmZ5cVhmT3M0UQ) — Yonhap称这是时隔9年首次，表明安全合作深化。
- [日本试探韩国解除福岛海鲜禁令](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOQldudi1Qd3k2R0VxRVotaHNjS3dSellNVHZUQWwyNk5XRUJFRFBjWU9vR3BpUkZvSUFVa2k0eFY3RWVwb2VKblJOMWg5LVBObTFneXJHWVdpMWxwb3d2VU5xZ3A2N0JYN2lxNFZIWnZjTVAxa2ktVmhXMGN1LUlqWmVsSmpsTlY0RjZHUHFSUi1kYzhENjBzUnFwVlVCSUkzaHZiNGU3ZElTd2s) — Japan Today报道，但韩国国内舆论压力较大。
- [韩国游客在日本失踪，最后一句话“10分钟后到”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQcktDeld0dlNhRDNYTFJtb3VXXzhRSFN4WkVwNnplU1QyQS01QzVlbGgtWjFJUS1ITjcxRkwzbkhmeEs1RDd1T2t6S0xkWTh5ZmRkczNLNnNySllBMHYteE13Y1c2emdMdzNHdnhTYWRzX0ZyUkVDTU5WS0gtejBaZUxSeVdqdkxoUWlxczlXRGpWSnpjbFpHRnd3VkZpdw) — 首尔经济日报报道，引发民间关注。
- [韩国总统提名第二位女总理](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNenBYWnotSnRwMEJsR3FBVGcxUEZvVFVxOWZKeTBCcG1BM1I4THJQZkYxRFRPNTZkLTg5YnBkMkIzLXZoZ2NHMXU3TUNBRE1adkhqZkl2b1Uwd1lfaE81MU9oTG93aEZDUk1Xdks4ZWJnVzlYdUllMDNtcXVsVWtvWkFZQXp5cTRGN0FyYnpzelM0RUlJZE1Nb1RlUVE) — 日本时报报道。
- [日本进入超老龄化社会](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxPSXozT0RHVWltRS1IV2dDV0YtOWZrMW9NMkN1V0tLR2c2TVJuOEEwTkxLSU1LNzU3NXlyZl9iRUtDYWw2VS1wSnZoWDdhcWdZQUF6N1NPaVJyUHZ1R2cta0llSWRRb2xXNS11X3VhTXFKdFFJWTRUdWE1ekRVM1M3T3J2YllmZUhfdld4VVZoWVl6UnlPbW5nWE9iWTloWjhYUXUw) — Japan Today分析。

日韩军事合作恢复是区域安全积极信号，但福岛海鲜争议若未能突破，可能限制民众好感度。
日韩.en:
Japan and South Korea are making significant strides in bilateral cooperation, resuming joint naval drills after a seven-year hiatus and holding search-and-rescue exercises for the first time in nearly a decade. At the same time, Japan is pushing for talks to lift South Korea's ban on Fukushima seafood, a sensitive issue tied to public health concerns. Domestically, South Korea is undergoing political change with a new prime minister nomination, while a mysterious disappearance of a South Korean traveler in Japan draws attention.

- **[Japan and South Korea resume joint Naval drills after seven-year pause](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOQ2lwSHh3RGNQcVc2bG9wZXdoOG5CcWpRSm03ejRBQldtLUhtRF9jV1VaWHl2UUctS3pETmRqaThFMkhCakdFeUpCazZPakJHcHNIcm5Rd2I0U0ZUY3F1Q0VPc3VWU0pxZGZzLTk5ZGF0VTI5ZUJnc04zVTFKRUZJZ2hPbzE1YnFDcjRrZXRCTlJaSUxiNk1ySGE1aW9NbjEzRTNLdA)** — The joint drills signal a major improvement in defense ties, particularly amid rising regional security threats from North Korea and China.
- **[Japan seeks talks with South Korea to lift Fukushima seafood ban](https://news.google.)** — This diplomatic push could improve economic relations, but domestic opposition in South Korea over food safety remains a major hurdle.
- **[South Korean president nominates would-be second woman PM](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNenBYWnotSnRwMEJsR3FBVGcxUEZvVFVxOWZKeTBCcG1BM1I4THJQZkYxRFRPNTZkLTg5YnBkMkIzLXZoZ2NHMXU3TUNBRE1adkhqZkl2b1Uwd1lfaE81MU9oTG93aEZDUk1Xdks4ZWJnVzlYdUllMDNtcXVsVWtvWkFZQXp5cTRGN0FyYnpzelM0RUlJZE1Nb1RlUVE)** — The nomination of a second female prime minister in South Korea reflects a gradual shift in gender representation in top political offices.
- **[South Korean Traveler Vanishes in Japan, Last Words Were "Arriving in 10 Minutes"](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQcktDeld0dlNhRDNYTFJtb3VXXzhRSFN4WkVwNnplU1QyQS01QzVlbGgtWjFJUS1ITjcxRkwzbkhmeEs1RDd1T2t6S0xkWTh5ZmRkczNLNnNySllBMHYteE13Y1c2emdMdzNHdnhTYWRzX0ZyUkVDTU5WS0gtejBaZUxSeVdqdkxoUWlxczlXRGpWSnpjbFpHRnd3VkZpdw)** — This incident has sparked media frenzy and may affect bilateral travel confidence if not resolved quickly.

**Signal:** The Japan-Korea rapprochement appears genuine and security-driven, but unresolved historical issues (seafood ban, territorial disputes) could still derail progress. Watch for any breakthrough in the seafood talks or further joint exercises.

中国.zh:
